title: FFT 1536
text: Computes fast-fourier-transform (FFT) for LTE standard transmission bandwidth of 15 MHz, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Rounding method} sets Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations; {Complex multiplication} sets the hDL implementation Use 3 multipliers, {Normalize butterfly output} sets the output normalization and {Enable reset input port} sets the optional reset signal. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero
